Rule.name: Generic Manager Correlation

Argument.name: log
Argument.Description: Logger to log statements. Note: This executes in the cloud, and logging is currently not exposed to anyone other than SailPoint.

Argument.name: idn
Argument.Description: Provides a read-only starting point for using the SailPoint API. From this passed reference, the rule can interrogate the Identity Security Cloud data model including identities or account information via helper methods as described in IdnRuleUtil.

Argument.name: link
Argument.Description: Read-only representation of account data that has been aggregated. Use this as a basis to determine manager linkages to a specific manager identity.

Argument.name: managerAttributeValue
Argument.Description: Attribute value stored in the manager attribute.

Argument.name: returnMap
Argument.Description: Map object containing a reference to the identity attributes to identify the manager's identity. These should contain both identityAttributeName and identityAttributeValue as keys.
